title: Shattered Skies

missions.title: The Mutiny at Cloud-Break
missions.blurb: The richest vault in the upper skies. One last job.

shots.line: They say there was ground, once. Then the world broke, and everything worth keeping rose into the sky.
Below the clouds is the Undertow. It crushes whatever falls in. Nobody has ever sailed back out of it.
Lift-Stone keeps the islands up. A Lift-Core keeps a ship up. Lose yours, and the Undertow gets you.
The Armada claims all of it. Their sky-lanes, their tax, and their noose for anyone who won't pay.
Scrappers, smugglers, Syndicate lords. Everyone else takes what they can from whoever's looking the other way.
And then there's the Sovereign Gale, the one ship the Armada never caught. The only home I've ever had.
I'm Vane. Deck rat, then gunner, now First Mate. Cassian pulled me off an Armada prison barge when I was twelve. I never asked why.
shots.speaker: vane
shots.cardRole: First Mate of the Gale. That's you.

shots.line: Eyes up, Vane. By tomorrow we'll have robbed the Armada blind, and every sky-lane from here to the Maelstrom will know my name.
shots.speaker: cassian
shots.cardRole: Most wanted pirate in the skies. Raised you.

shots.line: Give me one clear broadside, First Mate, and I'll put a hole in the moon.
shots.speaker: mirren
shots.cardRole: Master gunner. Loudest laugh in the fleet.

shots.line: Keep your limbs attached and my Lift-Core cool. That's all I've ever asked of you lot.
shots.speaker: odessa
shots.cardRole: Ship's surgeon, keeper of the Lift-Core.

shots.line: Wind's turned our way all week. Feels like luck. I've never trusted luck.
shots.speaker: tobin
shots.cardRole: Stormcaller. Reads the wind and the crew.

shots.line: Course is plotted, Vane. Cloud-Break, by the back door. Have I ever steered you wrong?
shots.speaker: morrow
shots.cardRole: Navigator, and your oldest friend aboard.

shots.line: The Sky Vault at Cloud-Break: every coin the Armada ever taxed. One last job, then none of us ever runs again. Freedom has a price, and tonight the Armada pays it.
shots.speaker: cassian

shots.line: By first light the vault was open and the gold was in our hold. Then the patrols found us.

lines.speaker: cassian
lines.text: Vault's cracked, Vane. Two patrols inbound. She's your ship: show them why.

lines.speaker: mirren
lines.text: Ha! Did you see that one fold?

teach.speaker: cassian
teach.text: Thumb on the stick, and bring her around.

teach.speaker: mirren
teach.text: Side-on to them, Vane, then hit BROADSIDE. All guns!

teach.speaker: tobin
teach.text: Need to close the gap? Hold BOOST and open her up. A quick tap rolls you clear of shots.

shots.line: Ha! Did you see that last one fold? Drinks are on the Armada tonight!
shots.speaker: mirren

shots.line: Sorry, Captain. The Armada pays better than you do.
shots.speaker: morrow

shots.line: Lift-Core's burning! Morrow locked the doors! We're going down!
shots.speaker: odessa

shots.line: One blast tore her open. And the Armada was already there, waiting, as if someone had told them where to look.
Vane! That scout off the rail! Get on it and get out! That's an order!
shots.speaker: cassian

lines.speaker: tobin
lines.text: Hull's going, Vane! Move!

teach.speaker: tobin
teach.text: She's still answering the stick! Barely!

teach.speaker: tobin
teach.text: Hold BOOST! Catch that scout before she drops!

teach.speaker: tobin
teach.text: If you need to, BROADSIDE still fires. Go!

teach.speaker: cassian
teach.text: GRAPPLE! Throw the hook when you're close!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Two guards. Fine. Time the strike as it lands.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: This is mine now.

shots.line: I cut the lines and watched her go. The Sovereign Gale, burning, falling into the clouds. Everyone I knew was on that ship.
shots.speaker: vane

shots.line: Cassian in irons, Admiral. Crew accounted for. The First Mate? Lost overboard.
shots.speaker: armada

shots.line: Lost. Good. Let them think so. I've got a stolen gunboat, a price on my head, and one name: Morrow.
shots.speaker: vane

missions.title: Leaking Lift-Gas
missions.blurb: The Scrap-Winds. Everyone here wants the bounty on your head.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Toxic cloud, floating junk and a leak in the lift-bag. Below the sky-lanes nobody asks questions.

lines.speaker: scav
lines.text: Well now. That's the gunboat with the Armada bounty on it. Open up, boys!

lines.speaker: scav
lines.text: Fresh meat! Mind the junk, she's a small ship!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: And there's a sky whale in these winds. If it opens its mouth at you, get off its line.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Sunk. And there goes everything they were carrying.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Careful. Every hit costs gold to patch.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Their guns glow before they fire. Tap BOOST and roll clear.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: She's wallowing! Get close and throw the hook!

teach.speaker: vane
teach.text: Only the Boss's ship is worth a boarding. Beat it under a quarter hull, get close, then GRAPPLE.

lines.speaker: scav
lines.text: You came aboard? You really are mad!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Barely worth the powder. Sink a ship and you get scrap. If I want real prizes, I need a better deck than that one.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: And I need someone who can shoot. The Armada is hauling a disgraced cannoneer through here in irons.

missions.title: The Disgraced Cannoneer
missions.blurb: An Armada brig skiff carries a prisoner who knows how their guns work.

lines.speaker: armada
lines.text: Unknown gunboat, you are in restricted sky. Turn back.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: She's wallowing. Close in and throw the hook!

teach.speaker: vane
teach.text: Beat her down, then get close and GRAPPLE. No sinking this one.

lines.speaker: armada
lines.text: Prisoner stays in irons! Hold the deck!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: You're not Armada. You're not rescue, either. What are you?

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Short a gunner. Know anything about their ships?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: I built half their gun drills. Hit the propellers, not the hull. A ship that can't run can't stop you walking onto it.

missions.title: The Lift-Stone Run
missions.blurb: The leak's getting worse. There's raw Lift-Stone adrift in a mine field, and you need it.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: That leak will drop us by morning. Raw Lift-Stone would seal it.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: And where do we get raw Lift-Stone?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Old mine field. The mines still work. Shoot them from far off, or fly around them.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Fly through the glowing stones. Keep clear of the mines, and of the green smog: it eats hulls.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: That's one. Keep going!

lines.speaker: scav
lines.text: Mine field's ours! Get him!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: She'll hold. Let's find something bigger to steal.

missions.title: Claim or Strip
missions.blurb: A salvage brig worth having, if you can take it in one piece.

lines.speaker: gorse
lines.text: A gunboat? Bold. I'll hang your hull from my bowsprit.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Engines are gone! She can't run. Get her under a quarter hull, then hooks on!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Hook's on! Stay close, the lines won't hold if you drift.

lines.speaker: gorse
lines.text: Not today, you lunatic! Full burn!

teach.speaker: rook
teach.text: Set AIM to ENGINES. Shoot the propellers and she can't run.

teach.speaker: rook
teach.text: A brig takes three hooks. Keep tapping GRAPPLE while you're close.

lines.speaker: gorse
lines.text: All right, it's your deck. Name your price, pirate.

missions.title: Dead-Weight
missions.blurb: Krag anchors ships and drags them into the Undertow. Then he picks through what's left.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Krag's fleet has the lane. He doesn't shoot you down. He harpoons you and takes you down with him.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: So when that harpoon comes, I climb it.

lines.speaker: krag
lines.text: I've sunk better than you for less. Down you go.

lines.speaker: krag
lines.text: Got you. Feel that? That's the Undertow, calling.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: We're being dragged down! Pour it on! Under a quarter hull, hit GRAPPLE and ride the line onto his deck!

lines.speaker: krag
lines.text: My balloon! You'll pay in scrap for that!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Line of fire's clear astern. Hit him from behind and it rakes the whole hull.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Bruisers at the winch! Cut through them!

phases.location: The Iron Maw, Open Cargo Bay

lines.speaker: krag
lines.text: Just you and me, and a long way down.

lines.speaker: krag
lines.text: No... the doors... get back!

lines.speaker: krag
lines.text: Enough! I'll drag you down myself!

lines.speaker: krag
lines.text: Winch is yours whatever happens, pirate. Now what about me and my ship?

missions.title: Eye of the Cyclone
missions.blurb: A smuggler's distress call from inside a storm that shouldn't be flyable.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Intercepted Armada traffic. Cassian's alive, Vane. They're holding him on the Tartarus Aloft. It never lands.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Then we go up after him. Who knows its flight path?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Three Syndicate lords, each with one cipher. And there's a wind-reader out there who could get us to them, if she survives the cyclone.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Whoever's out there, I can hear your engines! Stay high! Don't fight the wind, ride it!

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Yes! Let the current carry you, it'll double your speed!

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Nearly clear. Hold on a little longer!

teach.speaker: lyra
teach.text: Push the stick up to CLIMB, down to DIVE. Their guns can't angle far!

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: You flew into that on purpose? Either you're mad or you're useful. I read winds. Give me your helm.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: With her charts we can use the currents, and hide in the cloud banks. I've rigged chain-shot for sails, and fire-shot for decks.

missions.title: Haven Under Fire
missions.blurb: The Smugglers' Haven will sell you a lead on the ciphers, if it's still standing.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: The Smugglers' Haven. Every cipher lead in the Jetstream passes through here.

lines.speaker: runner
lines.text: You, with the harpoon! Syndicate hunters are on my tail. Get me to the dock and I'll tell you where Ashgrave flies.

lines.speaker: runner
lines.text: Keep them off me! I can't take many hits!

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: More coming in from the current!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: When their guns glow, tap BOOST to roll out of the way.

lines.speaker: runner
lines.text: You saved my neck. Ashgrave runs the western current, and never without an escort. That's the first cipher.

missions.title: First Cipher: Lord Ashgrave
missions.blurb: Ashgrave runs the western current and never flies without an escort.

lines.speaker: ashgrave
lines.text: No one flies my current without paying my toll.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: We're in the cloud. They can't see us. Your first volley will hit hard.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Chain-shot's tearing up the sails. Keep it on them!

lines.speaker: ashgrave
lines.text: Burn everything! Get me out of here!

teach.speaker: rook
teach.text: Tap AMMO to change shot. CHAIN wrecks engines, FIRE burns the crew you'll meet on deck.

lines.speaker: ashgrave
lines.text: You want the cipher? Come and take it, then.

lines.speaker: ashgrave
lines.text: The cipher's in my coat. Please. There's no need for this to get ugly.

missions.title: Second Cipher: The Assassin
missions.blurb: The second cipher is guarded by the Syndicate's best blade.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: They raid ships while the boarding party's away. Whoever you leave behind keeps our hull in one piece.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: So who boards, and who holds the helm?

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Whoever you are, turn around. I don't get paid extra for you.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: There's the courier. Ride the current behind them.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Take the bodyguards. Leave Sable standing. I want that blade on my side.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: You're not even trying to hit me. Why?

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: My bodyguards are down, and you held back. Nobody holds back.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: I've got a crew of outcasts and a grudge against the whole sky. Interested?

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Give me the run of any enemy ship. I'll set charges on their Lift-Core. Captains surrender quickly with a timer ticking under their feet.

missions.title: Third Cipher: Lady Thrace
missions.blurb: Thrace flies at the very top of the Jetstream, out of reach of most guns.

lines.speaker: thrace
lines.text: So you're the upstart who robbed Ashgrave. Do try to keep up.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Get me on that deck. Thrace won't last long with charges under her.

lines.speaker: thrace
lines.text: You can't catch what you can't reach!

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Charges going below. Keep them busy for five rounds.

lines.speaker: thrace
lines.text: Take your cipher, and spare me the speech.

missions.title: The Twin Corsairs
missions.blurb: Vex and Vesper hold the last leg of the route, and they hunt as a pair.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Twin clippers coming out of the sun. Vex and Vesper. Nothing we've got can catch both.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Then I won't catch both. I'll catch one, and use it to catch the other.

lines.speaker: vex
lines.text: Round and round we go, little brig.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Which one of us do you think you can catch?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Line's on! Vex can't slip that. Keep firing till she's under a quarter hull!

teach.speaker: rook
teach.text: Use Krag's HARPOON! Snag Vex's clipper, batter it under a quarter hull, then GRAPPLE up the line!

lines.speaker: vex
lines.text: Vesper! They're on my deck!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Cut the lines. Bring the old ship around behind us. I'm flying this one.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: VEX! You stole... you'll burn for that!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Now we're even on speed.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: That was my brother's ship!

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: The Mirage is the fastest thing in the sky. It always was. Do what you're going to do.

missions.title: Tartarus Aloft
missions.blurb: Three ciphers. One flying prison. Cassian is in the high-security brig.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: There. Above the cirrus. Tartarus Aloft, right where the ciphers said it would be.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Hold on, Cassian. I'm nearly there.

lines.speaker: armada
lines.text: Unidentified vessel, you will be fired upon.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: She's huge but she's slow. Stay out of her broadside.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Stairs to the cell block are aft. Move.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: It's dark down here. Keep together.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: This is the high-security brig? Maps. Wine. A feather bed.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: You always did have good timing, Vane. Sit down. You've come a long way for nothing.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: They told me you were in irons.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: I told them to tell you that. The age of free pirates is over. I sold them the crew and the Gale for a pardon and an admiral's coat. Morrow only did as I said.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: You raised me.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: And I'm sorry you lived. Warden, see to it.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Do try to make it quick. I've a fleet to run.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Cassian! Come back here!

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: You! The one who just got sentenced to death! I'm the Chief Engineer of this prison, and I've had enough of it.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: I can overdrive any Lift-Core you've got and patch a hull under fire. Get me off this barge.

missions.title: Assault Gliders
missions.blurb: They're not sinking you. They're coming aboard.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Assault gliders launching! They'll land on our deck and take the helm!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Choose who stays to hold the helm. Whatever gets past our guns lands on them.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Gliders inbound! Load FLAK and knock them out of the sky!

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Boarders on the stern! The defenders will have to hold!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: That's one less on our deck!

teach.speaker: thorne
teach.text: Hull taking a beating? Tap PATCH. I can do it once per fight.

teach.speaker: thorne
teach.text: Tap OVERDRIVE to redline the Lift-Core. Faster guns, faster ship.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: They're on the deck! Defend the helm!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: That's the first time anyone's boarded me. I didn't care for it.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: The blockade's still up. Warden Malakor's Ironclad holds the only gap, and it's the only ship left that can break it.

missions.title: The Warden
missions.blurb: Steal the Ironclad and punch through the blockade, while they try to take your ship.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: They'll come for our deck while we go for theirs. Who holds the helm, and who goes across?

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Whoever goes needs to be quick. I'll go. That Ironclad has a Lift-Core like anyone else's.

lines.speaker: malakor
lines.text: No one escapes my custody. Launch everything.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: That armor shrugs off round shot. Try MORTAR. It arcs over the plate at any altitude.

lines.speaker: malakor
lines.text: Engines? No! Get those hooks off!

teach.speaker: rook
teach.text: Tap AMMO until it reads MORTAR.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Gliders landed! We hold here while they board!

lines.speaker: malakor
lines.text: I've broken harder prisoners than you.

lines.speaker: malakor
lines.text: Impossible. This ship cannot be taken!

lines.speaker: malakor
lines.text: The Bastion answers to no prisoner. Well. It never did before.

missions.title: Eye of the Maelstrom
missions.blurb: The Armada is coming for the free havens. Show the pirates it can be beaten.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: A storm that never ends. That's where Cassian's staging. Nobody goes in there.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Then that's where we'll break his fleet. If the free captains see it can be done, they'll follow.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: When the air goes white around you, MOVE. That's lightning looking for a mast.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Updrafts here too. They'll throw you upward if you fly through.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: They're breaking! The free captains are watching this, Vane!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Flagship's breaking up! Take her deck and the whole sky sees it!

lines.speaker: armada
lines.text: Repel boarders! Not one pirate lives to tell it!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: To every free captain listening: the Armada bleeds. Follow me into the storm.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: One more thing. Morrow's ship's on the far side of the wall, running supply.

missions.title: Defend the Free Haven
missions.blurb: The coalition's first test. Hold the haven until the storm-fleet breaks.

lines.speaker: captain_ria
lines.text: Captain Ria of the free fleet, flying with you. Say the word, Vane.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: The Armada is coming for this haven. So we break them here, in front of everyone.

lines.speaker: captain_ria
lines.text: Free fleet, on Vane's wing!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Second wave! Frigates, with missiles!

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Missile! Roll out of its path!

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Ria's hull won't take much more of this.

lines.speaker: captain_ria
lines.text: They ran. They actually ran! Every free captain in the sky just saw that.

missions.title: The Navigator
missions.blurb: Morrow is running supply through the storm wall. This is personal.

lines.speaker: morrow
lines.text: Vane? You're supposed to be dead. Cassian's going to be so disappointed in me.

lines.speaker: morrow
lines.text: Not like this, not like this... full burn!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Morrow. You've got some explaining to do.

lines.speaker: morrow
lines.text: I've got the fleet's radar codes, and I know every weak point on the Gale. Let me make it right.

missions.title: Ship-Hopping
missions.blurb: The Gale is too heavily shielded to approach. So take its escorts, one at a time.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Convoy around the Gale. The frigate at the back has siege mortars that could reach her engines.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: So I jump on the corvette. From the corvette I jump on the frigate. And then I turn its guns around.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: That's the worst plan I've ever heard. I'll keep the old ship close.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Corvette's ahead. Shell her under a quarter hull, then hooks on, and go!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Quick. This deck won't last.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: One down. This corvette's on fire, so let's not stay long.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Is that my own frigate shelling me? Oh, Vane. I did teach you well.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Mortars on her engines. Set your AIM and keep firing.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Her engines are out! She's dead in the storm! That's your opening!

missions.title: The Sovereign Gale
missions.blurb: Your old home, in the heart of the storm. Finish it.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: Every free captain in the sky is behind you. Every Armada gun is in front.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Cassian taught me to take what I want, and that's the Gale.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Here we are, then. Come and take her, if you can.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Lightning's walking the storm wall. Keep moving!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: My armor! You'd really do this to her?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Broadside armor's stripped! Hooks, now!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: All of you, with me. This is our deck.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: They're breaking! Get below, Vane! Cassian's at the Lift-Core!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The core's failing. We'll fall together. It's almost fitting.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: You were the best thing I ever stole.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Then we burn together, Vane!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Go on, then. She's yours. Freedom always did cost someone else.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Lift-Core's holding! I don't know how, but she's holding!

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: The Armada's scattering, and Cassian went down with the old core. I've got the helm of the Sovereign Gale, and the whole sky to answer for.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Freedom has a price. I know exactly what I paid.

missions.title: Rook's Debt
missions.blurb: The officer who disgraced Rook is running powder through the Scrap-Winds.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: That's Commodore Hale's ship. Bring me alongside.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Remember me, Commodore?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Hale's powder recipe. Packed right, grapeshot catches fire on the way out.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Thank you, Vane. Now let's light something up.

missions.title: The Drowned Chart
missions.blurb: Lyra's old chart lies on a wreck deep in the storm.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Those looters are on my wreck. Ride the current in behind them.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: That captain took my chart aboard. Beat them down and let me at that deck!

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Give me back what you pulled off that wreck!

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: My mother's hand. She charted winds nobody believed in.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: You could have left me in that cyclone. I won't forget that.

missions.title: Krag's Hoard
missions.blurb: Krag's salvage caches are still adrift in the Scrap-Winds, and now they're yours.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Six caches, plenty of mines, and some very upset looters.

missions.title: Lyra's Currents
missions.blurb: Lyra wants to chart the fast winds, and needs someone mad enough to fly them.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Six chart beacons. Ride the currents between them, and try to enjoy it.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Three sky whales feed up here. When one opens its mouth, turn hard or roll.

missions.title: Blood Money
missions.blurb: Sable's old employer has put a price on her head.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: They came for me. You didn't have to come along.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: My old crew. This won't take long.

missions.title: Spare Parts
missions.blurb: Dr. Thorne wants the Lift-Core regulator from an Armada tender.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Please don't shoot the part I need. It's near the engines. Well, shoot around it.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Armada drills say hit the hull. Armada drills are written by people who've never had to fix one.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Is that why they threw you out?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: They threw me out because I refused to fire on a hospital barge. The drill book's just an added insult.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Commodore Hale signed my court-martial. He's running powder through here, you know.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Want to pay him a visit?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: I thought you'd never ask.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: I've been firing guns since I was nine. First time anyone's asked me where I think we should aim them.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: You're good at it.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: I know. It's still nice to hear.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Wind has moods. You just have to listen, and not take it personally.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Does it ever tell you anything useful?

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: It told me you'd come. Then it told me you'd be late.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: You've gone quiet since that war room.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: He taught me to shoot, Rook.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Then he taught you well. Use it on him.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: My mother mapped the deep currents. Her chart's still out there, on the wreck that killed her.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Then let's fetch it.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: You mean that? Nobody ever means that.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: When this is over, where will you go?

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Haven't thought that far.

lines.speaker: lyra
lines.text: Good. That's the right answer.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: You should know I've killed better captains than you.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: And now you work for me.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: I'm still deciding who works for whom.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: The Syndicate's put a price on me. It's insultingly low.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Want to go and complain?

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: In person. Yes, I think so.

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: He raised you. Cassian. I know what that's like, when they turn out to be exactly what you feared.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Does it stop hurting?

lines.speaker: sable
lines.text: No. But you do get sharper.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Your Lift-Core is a disgrace. Who's been maintaining it?

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Nobody.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: That explains the smell.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: I built half the Citadel's locks. Told myself it was only engineering.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: And now?

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Now I'd like one good regulator and a clean conscience, in that order.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Overdrive won't kill her. Probably. I'd stop short of testing that, mind you.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: You're getting fond of this ship.

lines.speaker: thorne
lines.text: Don't be ridiculous. It's a very good ship.

lines.speaker: morrow
lines.text: I'm not going to ask you to forgive me.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Good. Keep marking those weak points.

lines.speaker: morrow
lines.text: Aye. I know where every one of them is. I helped install them.

ending: The sky is yours. Free Skies stays open for as long as you want to fly it.
